name: Landings
summary: Screenshot gallery of 385+ landing page examples from leading companies, browsable by stack and color palette.
description: Landings collects landing page designs from real companies (Gusto, Patreon, Ghost, Icons8) as screenshots, each post showing the page, its color palette and its stack tags. Browse by stack (React, Next.js, Webflow, WordPress, Tailwind CSS, Framer) or color; the site also hosts a Tailwind CSS class reference and small SVG/color conversion tools.
contains: 385 landing page examples measured in the catalog
